messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Token-count divergence detected between shadow-emitter and billing-aggregate (Δ > 12%) for multiple windows. Alerting on-call.
maria-eng: acked. I'm on it, grabbing logs now.
josh-billing: saw alerts + a couple customer overage flags in the dashboard. Not sure if real, opening a quick query.
sre-lisa: pinging infra — any Kinesis/Kafka backlog? I see increased consumer lag for meter-aggregator in the last 10m.
eng-anthony: running tail on the emitter logs now. throwing a quick grep:
```
kubectl logs -f emitter-prod-2 | grep "emit_count" | tail -n 50
```
maria-eng: emitter looks healthy, but there's a strange pattern: emitter reports counts, but aggregator ingestion timestamps are delayed by ~30-60s. kafka_consumerlag metrics spiked.
josh-billing: quick customer-impact check: two customers got auto-notify overage emails at 12:04 and 12:06. CS told them it's likely transient. cs-zoe is there.
cs-zoe: i'm on the customer thread, asking them to hold while we triage. They're seeing a single-day spike on their dashboard; unsure if billed yet.
billing-bot: shadow_count=1_234_567 canonical_count=1_089_432 window=5m Δ=13.3% (source: billing-aggregator v2.1.3)
maria-eng: hypothesis: intermittent aggregator commit lag resulting in double-count when retries happen downstream. Need to confirm duplicate writes vs delayed emits.
sre-lisa: checking storage write latency to ledger-db. There's a commit timeout at 12:01-12:07 to rdb-primary, retries from writer consumed increased.
eng-anthony: repro command: querying kafka offsets vs aggregated offsets
```
# quick offsets diff
python scripts/offset_diff.py --topic=token-emits --agg-table=usage.window5m
```
eng-anthony: result: emitter offset advanced, but aggregator last_processed_offset lags and then jumps forward (batch apply). some in-flight retries coincide with jump -> possible duplicate application.
josh-billing: if duplicates are applied we overcount; what mitigations? can we flip aggregation idempotency or dedupe window?
maria-eng: immediate mitigations:
- pause auto-notify emails (cs-zoe) — don't want more customers alerted
- set aggregator to conservative write-mode (disable immediate-ack batching) to avoid double-apply
- kick off reconcile job to compute canonical counts and generate patch deltas
sre-lisa: I can flip the aggregator flag `AGG_BATCH_ACK=false` in staging then prod if QA ok. Doing a small canary on one shard first.
cs-zoe: paused notifications for billing-overages via admin UI — confirmed.
billing-bot: scheduled reconcile job job-1751239999-reconcile at 12:30 UTC. dry-run mode first.
maria-eng: rolling canary: patching aggregator on shard-3 now. command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/aggregator AGG_BATCH_ACK=false -n prod --record
```
maria-eng: canary looks stable for 2 mins, no retries visible, consumer lag reduced slightly.
eng-anthony: reconcile dry-run output indicates ~0.4% of counts would be corrected on the canonical side — mostly small deltas, but a handful of accounts > 10%.
cs-zoe: flagged affected customers in CRM, prepared templated message but holding until we have final counts. customers asked for ETA.
josh-billing: ETA: full reconcile run + validation ~40m. If we need to rollback, we can re-enable original mode.
maria-eng: next steps:
- continue canary rollout across shards (maria-eng)
- run reconcile in dry-run -> validate -> apply (josh-billing)
- inform CS customers with preliminary ETA (cs-zoe)
- check for any other automated notifications to pause (sre-lisa)
sre-lisa: noted. also adding a temporary metric alert to watch duplicate-apply-rate and consumer_lag > 30s.
eng-anthony: logging small snippet of suspected duplicate write pattern for postmortem:
```
2026-03-17T12:02:14Z emitter: offset=123456 partition=4 count=512
2026-03-17T12:03:45Z aggregator: processing offset=123456 partition=4 apply_start
2026-03-17T12:03:46Z aggregator: retry write to ledger-db idempotency_key=null timeout
2026-03-17T12:03:47Z aggregator: re-apply offset=123456 partition=4 -> duplicate
```
maria-eng: canary rolled to 5/8 shards. consumer_lag trending down. reconcile dry-run complete, generating patch file.
josh-billing: running reconcile apply now in controlled window. monitoring.
billing-bot: reconcile job status: started (job-1751239999-reconcile) pid=9876
cs-zoe: updated customers with ETA ~45m and said we'll follow up with reconciled numbers. they're appreciative of the clear comms.
eng-anthony: reconcile finished: applied corrections. affected accounts: 7 with >10% change, 120 with 1-10% adjustments. no billing charged changes applied retrospectively — we'll send corrected statements if needed.
josh-billing: created support tickets for the 7 impacted customers. billing adjustments queued; ops to verify before issuing refunds/credits.
maria-eng: starting postmortem doc draft: collecting timestamps, metrics, config change that caused aggressive batching combined with ledger-db transient latency -> duplicate writes path. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1751239999
sre-lisa: re-enabling auto-notify once we've got sanity checks in place? recommendation: keep paused for 1 hour post-fix to bake metrics.
cs-zoe: confirmed keep paused, will update customers after 1h with final note.
maria-eng: closing pager, monitoring for 30m. great fast response everyone. :clap:
oncall-bot: Incident resolved, severity: P2, duration: 00:52:21, responders: maria-eng, josh-billing, eng-anthony, sre-lisa, cs-zoe. Postmortem assigned to maria-eng.
